page.title: History
page.purpose: Help the operator find past decisions and inspect how they were resolved.

states.description: The first read is in flight; placeholder rows hold the place and are announced as loading.
No decision matches the status and search; the empty notice says how to widen it.
Rows are shown while a refresh or a further page failed; the failure is said above the list and Retry keeps the rows.
The read failed: the cause is named with a retry, or the sign-in card when the owner session is missing.
Rows from an earlier read stay on screen while a refresh runs, and the footer says how long ago they were updated.
A sort, urgency or sender filter is in force beside the status filter; each is removable in one tap.
